title: From A-Z: All the Best Memorial Day Deals to Shop Right Now
summary: 2026 Memorial Day deals are here at Amazon, Walmart, QVC, Nike, Nordstrom, Everlane, Coach, La Roche-Posay, Macy's, REI, Samsung & more.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Memorial Day has always been one of the biggest shopping days of the year.

With so much to shop for, from new furniture to deals on cosmetics, things can get a little hectic. Not to worry: We’ve made things easy for you by rounding up a list of some of the best Memorial Day sales and summer savings on top items that you can buy now.

From Anthropologie to Macy’s , see below for Memorial Day deals to shop and a running list of retail destinations offering discounts on TVs, headphones, grills, appliances, patio furniture, clothing, jewelry, shoes, beauty items, mattresses and a bunch of other incredible savings for the holiday weekend.

Nike Cortez Leather

$84.97 $125 32% off

Buy Now at nike

You can save an extra 20% off select sale items using the code START at checkout on Nike’s website. The Cortez is a foundational silhouette for Nike and remains a popular style even though it is 50+ years old .

Nike’s Cortez silhouette usually retails for $90 up to $100+, depending on the composition. The retailer is offering a full-leather style for $84.97 right now, 32% off its OG price . Steep deal aside, this style is a unique one with full black leather uppers that give the style an elegant twist akin to a dress shoe. If you’re worried about those textile uppers creasing, not to worry, Nike reengineered the fabric to prevent warping. Ample sizing is still available for both men and women, but you’ll want to act fast; it’s likely these sneakers won’t be in stock for long because of the steep markdown and unique makeup.

Versace Unisex Polarized Sunglasses

$192 $384 50% off

Buy Now at macy's

Designer sunglasses on Macy’s website are heavily marked down for Memorial Day, up to 50% off.

This is an aviator style from Versace, currently 50% off , which is a pretty great deal for designer eyewear. Plus, this model is unisex, offering equal opportunity for all shoppers. We like these sunglasses because they aren’t screaming designer. The logo detailing on the sides is subtle and not in your face. It’s enough of a logo flash to flex without looking pretentious.

Bose QuietComfort Ultra Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds

$179 $299 40% off

Macy’s is currently offering up to 20% to 40% off electronics on tech items from Bose, JBL, Beats, Canon and more.

Bose’s QuietComfort Ultra Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds were launched back in 2023. Since then, the style has become a best-seller for the tech brand for its premium audio quality. The style’s defining feature is its noise-cancelling abilities that quiet superfluous noise on commutes, long flights or in noisy offices. The sound is rich, immersive and all-encompassing, an impressive feat for an in-ear style. Plus, prolonged wear for hours on end is still comfortable. These earbuds are 40% off now at Macy’s, now $179, which is a great price for pretty outstanding when considering the noise cancellation and audio quality these Bose buds provide.

Carmen Mini Crossbody Bag With Newspaper Print

$140 $350 60% off

Buy Now at coach outlet

Coach Outlet has tons of designer items on sale, including bags under $100. The bag selection is superb with styles of all sizes.

We chose this bag, yes, for the price, it’s currently 60% off , but also because it reminds us of Carrie Bradshaw’s iconic Dior newspaper dress created by John Galliano . This mini bag doubles as a crossbody thanks to an included strap. Its print is especially cute with newspaper clippings that look almost secoupaged on. We’d purchase this because it is a statement piece, unlike anything we’ve seen Coach put out before.

Stanley All Day Julienne Mini Soft Cooler Bag and Lunch Box 7.4 Quarts

$75.00 $100.00 25% off

Buy Now On Amazon

Stanley’s coolers come in a wide variety of color options from muted tan and cream to neon hues.

While they’re best known for their tumblers, Stanley’s coolers are just as good and criminally underrated. The brand’s line is discounted up to 25% off now on Amazon. That’s $75 for a 7.4-quart cooler that should come in handy this summer for pool parties, tailgates and more. It also doubles as a lunch bag with a handy shoulder strap. Stanley claims you can pack up to 10 cans in this bag, enough to get a party going. It is also expertly insulated, keeping your drinks and snacks cool for up to 12 hours.

Cloudfoam Pure 2.0 Shoes

$45 $75 40% off

Buy Now at adidas

The Cloudfoam Pure 2.0 was released in 2021. The shoe is praised for its lightweight feel. These are not made for running, but they were inspired by running shoes.

Quality running shoes always come at a hefty price. This Memorial Day, you can get quality lifestyle footwear at a fraction of the normal price at Adidas. Take the brand’s Cloudfoam Pure 2.0 Shoes , now $45. The outsoles are plush and springy, offering ample bounce back, making each step count. If the $45 price tag wasn’t enough, you can also get an extra 30% off on this sneaker with code SCORE at checkout.

Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Plus (newest model)

$29.99 $49.99 40% off

This is the latest model of Amazon’s Fire TV Stick HD. According to Amazon, the new controller is 30% slimmer and can be powered through a TV’s USB port, so no need for a wall adapter.

This is the newest model of Amazon’s Fire TV Stick. The tech is $29.99 now for Memorial Day , down from $49.99. It features changes made to the functionality and size. According to Amazon, the gadget is 30% slimmer, making it more portable than ever, and can be powered through a TV’s USB port, foregoing the use of a wall adapter utilized in older models. The gadget plugs into your TV, instantly turning any television into a smart TV. This means you can access the internet, use apps and stream live TV.

Ninja CREAMi, Ice Cream Maker

$169 $199 15% off

Buy Now at walmart

The Ninja CREAMi Ice Cream Maker became super popular when it launched back in 2021 because it simplified the ice cream-making process, making it more accessible to everyone.

The viral Ninja Ice Cream maker is $169 off at Walmart . Scoop up this deal while you can. It comes with two-pint containers to hold as much ice cream or sorbet as you can muster. This tech is perfect for those days when you want ultra-creamy ice cream, without the hassle.

TIKI Brand Smokeless 25 in. Patio Fire Pit

$276.49 $395.00 30% off

This is a wood-burning fire pit that emits no smoke. This is one of many deals Amazon currently has on outdoor furniture, with discounts up to 34% off.

Cozy up over the holiday weekend and throughout the summer with this outdoor fire pit . This smokeless fire pit emits a flame with a four-foot heat radius and measures 25 inches in outside diameter. The product also includes a stand and cover to protect the fire pit from the elements.

KitchenAid Artisan Mini 3.5Qt Tilt-Head Stand Mixer & Glass Bowl

$279.98 $479 42% off

Buy Now at qvc

QVC is running deals up to 40% off on over 1,000 items. Plus, you can get an extra 15% off clearance items.

Crocs Adult Baya Clog

$34.99 $54.99 36% off

This is a unisex style. Some models are also retailing for $39.99, depending on the colorway.

If you’re in the market for a pair of clogs, get these Crocs adult Baya clogs for just $34.99 . We like the style because they’re breezier than a normal house slipper, giving you a…
